notes.title: Quests, 5 new skills, More Enemies, In-game chat
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Added an npc with a 4 quests. Added 5 new skills. Press enter to chat in-game. Added more mid-tier enemies with spawns spread out over the map. When you die all abilities lose 1 point.

Features/Fixes

Hearth Fire - players within the fire circle skill regain HP.

Ignite Air - mid-air platform creation.

Fire Shield - reduces damage from players.

Burndown - makes fire shield last longer.

Cooldown - decrease fire shields cool down longer.

Dash with the f key.

Cast Shockwave with the v key or change the key in the launcher.

Cast Fire Shield with the g key.

Max points of rapid fire set to 3 to avoid spam

Increased enemy hut xp

Spell power affects fire blast

Small ember optimization, more to come

Small ember has a max charge time of 2 seconds, more to come

Npc pathfinding bugfixes

More enemy spawn locations

Upcoming

More enemy and map variety 

More bugfixes

More skills

More quests

notes.title: Healing, Dash Re-work, More Skill Options
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

If you go the center of the building the fire circle now heals every half second you stand in the circle. Added 2 new skill upgrades. Removed the map colliders so the whole map explorable. Double press shift to dash.

New Skill Options!

Rapid Fire - reduces the cooldown of ember for each point.

'Book it' - reduces the cooldown of dash for each point.


Features/Fixes

Double tap shift to dash

fix more enemy bugs

added toggles to hide and show leader boards and tutorial text

cooldown for fire circle to avoid the effects slowing down other players games


Coming Soon!

Quests!

Hearth Fire - players within the fire circle skill regain HP.

More bug fixes

More spells, more detailed map, more enemies!

notes.title: Added a World Boss, More Quality of Life and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Added giant high-level world boss deep in the forest. The boss gives 500 xp to the player that gets the last hit. Increased ember charge effectiveness to do 3x damage to encourage the choice between quick small damage hits or risky high damage hits. Reworked spell damage and power gain slightly to avoid players getting one-shot randomly (as much). Added a bunch of quality of life and small bug fixes.

Features/Fixes

World Boss

Increased ember cooldown

Increased ember charge damage

Smaller crosshair

Increased camera range of motion 

First person mode (slide the camera zoom slider all the way to the left)

Spells now won't allow you waste upgrade points if you've already reached the max points for that spell

Larger map area

Camera verticle offset settings slider

Crosshairs now adjust based on camera offset, camera height, and zoom settings slider - still needs tweaking to make it feel right 100% of the time 

NPC health bars only show up for a few seconds after the enemy is damaged  

Better fireblast description

Auto sprint toggle

invert y-axis toggle


Some upcoming features/fixes - more to be added!

Resting mechanic

Damage mitigation skills versus players

Damage healing skills

Numbers on HP bar

Increase hp with each level

More higher level enemies 

Fire blast increasing size based on charge

Better fireblast effects and animations

More bug fixes

Better world bosses

Larger map area - colliders that make sense

Crosshairs now adjustment tweaks

double-tap to dash

show tutorial settings

fix leaderboard to have highest-ranked past 6 players

leaderboard spacing error

notes.title: Crosshair Aiming, Over the Shoulder Camera Settings and Leaderboard!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

I added an over the shoulder camera with crosshairs for easier aiming. Players can individually adjust the camera offset and zoom through sliders in the settings menu. I also added a leaderboard that shows the highest level players currently playing.

Features/Fixes
Better aiming - crosshairs and over the shoulder camera settings

Camera zoom and offset sliders

Added leader board

Fixed spelling

More tutorial text

Upcoming Updates!

Add healing spells

Fix right-click movement speed bug

Add player name tags
